reviewer_notes: Article Twenty One A.1 (TEMPORARY LEAVES OF ABSENCE) supplies all the restrictions both candidates list: request 'five (5) school days prior to the leave day,' emergency call-in under the normal sick leave procedure, use 'for sound, pressing and unavoidable reasons only,' and no use 'to extend a vacation week or a long weekend.' The clause begins on PDF page 30 (printed footer 29) and its last quoted sentence carries onto PDF page 31, so A's page 30 is correct while B's page 29 is the printed footer, off by one. Both answers omit the A.1 verification sentence on PDF page 31 ('may be subject to verification provided that the Superintendent has a bonafide reason to believe that the day was not taken in compliance'), which I treated as incompleteness rather than error since the governing restrictions are captured.
